newsitem.title: GERMANY: German forwarders assocation adds logistics title.
newsitem.headline: German forwarders assocation adds logistics title.

text.p: The German freight forwarders association BSL said it has changed its name to include logistics and dropped the previous warehousing title.
The German name of the association is now the "Bundesverband Spedition und Logistik e.V." (BSL) instead of "Bundesverband Spedition und Lagerei e.V." (BSL), a statement said.
The new name, agreed at a members' conference last week, reflects the changing role of freight forwarders and increasing importance of logistics services, the BSL said.

A survey carried out last year on the image of forwarders had shown forwarding services were mostly connected with logistics and that logistics increasingly determined the activities of forwarders, it added.
